evidenceBasis: Owner screenshots from Travelpayouts Earthrightnow project showing Generate links controls.
rule: A Generate links control confirms account-side link generation is available. It does not authorize automatic public placement; ERN still requires utility review, exact-link verification and disclosure.

nextBest.why: Global eSIM utility; low-maintenance if country coverage and exact tracked link are verified.
Strong city-arrival/departure utility for walkable cities and transport hubs.
Airport/resort transfer utility where exact route coverage exists.
Useful in islands and independent-driving destinations if destination coverage is confirmed.
Broad car-rental candidate for road-trip destinations; use only as one selected rental option.
Flight-planning layer for remote destinations; never a camera-ranking driver.
Strong Asia activities/transport complement where inventory materially differs from existing partners.
City-pass utility for supported major cities.

platformModel2026.connectionModel: Since 2026-04-27, projects are automatically connected to relevant programs when available; some programs/tools are instant, some require project review, and some may be unavailable under brand requirements.
platformModel2026.exactLinkWorkflow: Travelpayouts Links can generate a partner deep link to a specific supported brand page once that program is available to the selected Project. SubID is optional and can be used for ERN placement analytics.
platformModel2026.safetyForERN: Program availability does not equal public-placement approval. ERN still requires distinct visitor utility, exact destination/coverage review, generated tracked-link verification and disclosure.
platformModel2026.automationBoundary: Travelpayouts also offers Drive/LinkSwitcher-style automation, but ERN keeps automatic placement and automatic link rewriting disabled to preserve editorial control and commercial-neutral Earth ranking.
platformModel2026.ownerActionWhenReady: For a selected opportunity, open Travelpayouts Tools > Links for the Earthrightnow Project, choose the available program, paste the exact destination/brand page, optionally assign an ERN SubID, generate the tracked link, then manually verify the result before public activation.
